subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should stable repeated failed exec outcomes ignore volatile output and be allowed to trip critical/global blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it deliberately changes when agent execution is stopped for repeated failed exec calls, so maintainers need to accept the availability tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree this is the desired runaway-session protection.

options.title: Defer For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want fuzzy result matching or session-wide loop policy settled before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree this is the desired runaway-session protection.
